content: Bho, Myahude abhi na chindu bhole kupeta bhandu bhange? Au bho, kuheketa jando kubhi na nyonjeka bhole?
Kubhi na nyonjeka ngolongwa kwa kila indela. Kutumbula, Chapanga akabhapekihi Bhayahude malobhi ghaki.
Nambu, bho, anakubya bhole anangati bhakumu bhabhu ngachebhahobhalile? Bho, kulepakuhobhalela kwabhu anakubhoha ulongwana waka Chapanga?
Ngabhela! Chapanga ahighalila kubha ndongwana chikahi chokapi, hata ngati kila mundu nde mpuhe, ngati moilembakike mu Malembu Mahuhu,
Nambu anakubhi uhakau ghotuhenga ulangi uchakaka waka Chapanga, bho, tupwagha kike? Bho, Chapanga le muhakau joaleta inyela? Pambani nongela kimundu.
Ngabhela! Kwa ndandi anangati bhenibhela nde mokubhelile, bho, Chapanga anaaweza bholi kuutemula ndema?
Nambu anakubhi chakaka jaka Chapanga jijonjukiki kulangiya ulumbalilu waki kwa ndandi ja upuhi wangu, bho, maghambu kiki nepani ndemulika kubha mwana mahoku?
Na tepani maghambu ki ngatwipwagha, ngati bhangi mobhatukopunganela kubha tupwagha, “Bho, tuhenga le mahakau nahuli ghambone ghapata kuhika?” Bhombi anabhatemulikaje ngati moibhapalakila.
Njeta joabhi wambone
Bho, tupwagha bhole henu? Bho, tepani Bhayahude le twambone kupeta bhandu bhange? Ngabhela hata pachokope! Maghambu tujomwi kubhalangiya Bhayahude na Bhagiliki kubha na bhombi bhabhi pahi ja mahoku.
Ngati moilembakake mu Malembu Mahuhu,

content.text: Njeta hata mundu jumu joabhi na mbulau,
wala njeta hata jumu joandonda Chapanga.
njeta joahenga ghambone, njeta hata jumu.
Milomu jabhu nde ngati matengele ghaghahoghuliki,
mu milomu jabhu kupita malobhi ghaghabhi na chikau ngati chikau cha lijoka.
Milomu jabhu jitweli masolu na mabhinilu.
Pokapi pabhajenda bhaleta uyonangeku na mang'ahiku.

content: Henu tumanyi kubha mambu ghokapi ghaghapwagha mu Shelia, ghapwagha kwa bhala bhabhabhi pahi ja Shelia, nahuli kila ndomu ngawikubha na chakukopunganela, na kulangiha kubha ndema wokapi ubhi pahi ja utemulo waka Chapanga.
Maghambu njeta mundu hata jumu joanajetakaliwa palongi jaka Chapanga kwa matendu gha Shelia, kwa ndandi kumanya mahoku kuhika kwa indela ja Shelia.
Kujetakalewa na Chapanga kwa indela ja uhobhalelu
Nambu sajenu, indela jaka Chapanga ja kubhajetakela bhandu kubha bhambone jijomwi kumanyikana, kabhete panga na Shelia. Na Shelia na bhalota bhaka Chapanga bhalandila lijambu leniheli.
Kubhalangika bhambone na Chapanga kupatikana kwa indela ja uhobhalelu kwaka Yesu Kristo kwa bhokapi bhabhahobhalela, kwa ndandi njeta tofauti jokapi jela:
maghambu bhokapi bhahengiki mahoku na kukepakewa na ulumbalilu waka Chapanga.
Bhandu bhokapi bhajetakalewa kubha bhambone waka, kwa chihomu chaka Chapanga, kwa indela ja ukombola ghoubhi muka Yesu Kristo.

Chapanga akumbohiki Yesu kubha nyambiku ja ujonganeshu, nahuli kwa mwahi waki, abya indela ja kubhabhokeha bhandu mahoku ghabhu kwa uhobhalelu wabhu kwaki. Chapanga akahengiki bhenibhela nahuli aweza kulangiha wamboni waki. Kwa ndandi pamwandi hapa Chapanga akabhi ahinakila panga kulolakela mahoku gha bhandu.

Nambu sajenu Chapanga ahengiki bhenibhela nahuli apata kulangi kubha nde umbone wa ntundu bhole ghoubhi na samani palongi jaki, nahuli abya wambone na joambalangi wambone mundu jola joanhobhalela Yesu.
Bhela, bho, kulilumbalila kubhi kwako? Njeta! Bho, kwa Shelia ja ntundu bhole? Bho, kwa Shelia ja matendu? Ngabhela! Nambu kwa Shelia ja uhobhalelu.
Bhela, sajenu tubhona kubha mundu ajetakalewa palongi jaka Chapanga kwa uhobhalelu, panga na matendu gha Shelia.
Au bho? Chapanga le nde Chapanga wa Bhayahude kanjika jabho? Bho, jombi le nga Chapanga wa mataifa ghokapi? Ena, jombi nde Chapanga wa mataifa ghokapi bhelabhela.

Anangati chakaka kubhi na Chapanga jumu pela, joanabhabhalangya bhambone bhala bhabhahekiti jando kwa uhobhalelu, na bhala bhangakuheketa jando anaabhabhalangya bhambone kwa indela ja uhobhalelu bhelabhela.
Bho, tutumila uhobhalelu nahuli kujibhoha Shelia heji? Ngabhela hata pachokope! Nambu tujipekeha Shelia samani jaki kamili.
